findings.source: Fanatic: И кричал вот так вот: УАААААААА.
findings.currentTarget: Fanatic: Naye alipiga kelele hivi: UAAAAAAA.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Fanatic: Naye apige kelele hivi: UAAAAAAA.
findings.objectiveReason: The preceding unit gives the instructions Fanatic told the man to follow (говорю, чтобы ... вышел ... и кричал). Alipiga converts the instructed shouting into an asserted completed event. Apige retains the instruction and does not invent confirmation that he followed it.
